title: Ginger Pork Ramen
description: A hearty and flavorful Japanese dish, perfect for a cold day. Savor the rich pork broth and tender noodles.
instructions: 1. In a large pot, heat the infused oil over medium heat.
2. Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the grated ginger and minced garlic, cooking for another minute.
4. Pour in 4 cups of pork broth and bring to a boil.
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Cook the ramen noodles according to the package instructions.
7. To assemble the bowls, place a portion of noodles in the bottom.
8. Add sliced pork, green onions, and a ladle of hot broth.
9. Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
